mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can impair renal function; methotrexate clearance depends on glomerular filtration, and foscarnet-induced nephrotoxicity may increase methotrexate accumulation and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, consider dose adjustment of methotrexate based on creatinine clearance, and monitor for signs of methotrexate toxicity including cytopenias and mucositis.
